verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own marketing addresses all three walls in the story: forms, CAPTCHAs and login prompts are 'handled' [docs-10], agents get past 'login walls included' [docs-8], and agents fill out applications and government forms [docs-13]. The support is asserted only at the landing-page level, and the documented `pauseWhen` feature [docs-23] suggests some flows may still stop and wait for human input. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how CAPTCHAs are solved (stealth, fingerprinting, proxies), docs on how login credentials and sessions are handled, and independent or hands-on proof that walls are passed without manual intervention.
